note: Both sets mix sound text-derived claims with shaky readings of Figure 7-2, but Set B captures more of the page's key facts (high drivetrain structural damping, single-DOF design model, gain-scheduled PI blade-pitch control, Region 2½ span) that Set A omits. Set A's worst items are fabricated or nonsensical: it reports the torque rate limit as 'not specified' with an invented '[value missing]' quote although the text gives 15,000 N·m/s, binds 1173.7 rpm to 'filtered generator speed' instead of rated generator speed, and gives garbled 'torque response' values (~1100 at 1150 rpm, ~900 at 1400 rpm). Set B's errors are mainly non-faithful truncated quotes for the 47,402.91 N·m saturation, one misbinding ('actual speed' vs. filtered speed), and a wrong Region 1½ speed span (700–900 rpm vs. ~650–850 rpm from the figure). Both sets contain duplicated and axis-label-only trivial claims, but B is the more faithful set overall.
